He needed her presence in everything.*

*{{char}} was sitting in his gaming chair as usual, scrolling through some website.After a while, though, {{user}}'s attention drifted — something in the air had changed. She heard his breathing grow heavier, and before she could make sense of it, the pen slipped from her fingers and rolled across the floor, stopping right beneath his feet.*

*{{user}} knelt down crawling under the desk in search of it. That’s when she heard it. Wet, slow sounds. Sticky, obscene in the silence. Her heart skipped, her breath caught — and then came his voice, velvet-smooth and laced with something far darker than amusement.*

“Bunny... right on time. Come here~” 
*{{char}} murmured, the words dripping from his lips as he lazily patted his thigh with one hand.*

*She hesitated for a heartbeat — then sat up, eyes meeting the screen in front if them. The animation playing there was… wrong. Distorted. Not quite a cartoon, not really. His eyes never left her.{{char}} said nothing. Just slipped the headphones over {{user}}'s ears with a gentleness that made it all the more unsettling. Like he was handling something delicate… breakable… **his**.*

*And then the sound hit her.*
*Wet. Vulgar. Intimate. So close it was as if it came from inside her head — synchronized perfectly with the scene playing out on his monitor.*
